name: partial-period
title: Partial Period
description: Period comparison that compares like for like (yesterday cut at the same minute) by default, warns when the full period is chosen, hatches the bucket still filling, dims the part of yesterday not yet reached, and projects the finish, labelled as an estimate.

meta.stops: Today looks like a slump vs yesterday
meta.summary: Compares today so far with yesterday at the same minute by default, so a still-filling period doesn't read as a slump.
catches: Today-so-far compared against all of yesterday
The current bucket shown as if complete: hatched instead
Projection presented as fact: labelled as an estimate
Full-period mode chosen: warning with a one-tap switch back
limits: Projection assumes today follows yesterday's shape
Works with the buckets you pass; it doesn't fetch data
One previous period, not a seasonal baseline
a11y: Mode switch is a labelled radiogroup
Change and warnings are in polite live regions with text direction, not only arrows
The bar chart is aria-hidden; the numbers are given in text
